description: Education Quiz system: daily quiz mini-game about nature/science/culture topics, quiz catalogue with question bank, QuizComponent, QuizSystem, reward mechanism (coins + energy), quiz-related achievement, NPC 'Professor Owl' as quiz host, and full i18n across 12 locales.
steps: 1. Create packages/game-engine/src/quiz/ directory with: quizDefinitions.ts (QuizQuestion interface with id, questionKey, answerOptions as array of {key, correct boolean}, category, difficulty; question bank of 12-16 questions across 3-4 categories: nature, science, culture, geography), quizOps.ts (pure functions: getDailyQuiz using day number from WorldClock to deterministically select 3 questions, answerQuestion, calculateReward, canTakeQuiz checking cooldown), quizState.ts (QuizState type: 'idle'|'active'|'reviewing'|'completed'), index.ts re-exporting.

2. Create packages/game-engine/src/components/QuizComponent.ts extending Component('quiz') with fields: state (QuizState), currentQuestions (QuizQuestion[]), currentIndex (number), answers (boolean[]), lastQuizDay (number for cooldown), streak (consecutive correct days), version.

3. Create packages/game-engine/src/systems/QuizSystem.ts extending System with requiredComponents ['quiz','inventory','stats']. Logic: when quiz is started, load daily questions; when answer is submitted, record and advance index; when all answered, compute rewards (coins per correct answer, bonus for streak, energy restore); enforce one quiz per in-game day cooldown.

4. Add NPC 'professor_owl' to packages/game-engine/src/world/NpcCatalogue.ts with role 'teacher', add 'teacher' to NpcRole type, add schedule with 'teaching' activity, add 'teaching' to NpcActivity type in npcSchedule.ts.
5. Add dialogue tree for Professor Owl explaining the quiz system and offering to start it.
6. Add 1 new achievement to packages/game-engine/src/achievements/achievementDefinitions.ts: 'quiz_streak_3' (complete quiz 3 days in a row). Add 'quiz_streak' condition kind to AchievementCondition.
7. Export new component and system from packages/game-engine/src/index.ts and related barrel files.

8. Add i18n keys to all 12 locale files: npc.owl.name, npc.activity.teaching, dialogue.owl.*, quiz.title, quiz.start, quiz.correct, quiz.incorrect, quiz.complete, quiz.streak, quiz.reward, quiz.cooldown, quiz.question.* (all question/answer keys), achievement.quiz_streak_3.*.
9. Update ITEM_NAME_KEYS (if needed) and NPC_ACTIVITY_KEYS in apps/web/src/i18n/index.ts for 'teaching'.

10. Write comprehensive tests in packages/game-engine/src/__tests__/quiz.test.ts covering: quiz definition validation (all questions have exactly one correct answer), getDailyQuiz determinism (same day = same questions), answer recording, reward calculation (base + streak bonus), cooldown enforcement, QuizSystem update with entities.
11. Run pnpm format && pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm test to verify.
acceptance_criteria: QuizComponent exists as pure data with 'quiz' type string
QuizSystem processes entities with quiz+inventory+stats components
quizOps.ts contains pure functions for quiz logic
12-16 quiz questions defined across 3-4 categories with i18n keys for all text
getDailyQuiz is deterministic: same day number always returns same questions
One quiz per in-game day cooldown is enforced
Streak tracking works correctly across consecutive days
NPC Professor Owl added with teacher role, schedule, and dialogue
All 12 locale files have matching keys for all new user-facing strings
All tests pass including new quiz.test.ts with at least 12 test cases
pnpm build succeeds with no type errors
